about_the_game:
As an up-and-coming member of parliament, you watch as your party clouds the future of the nation by diverting funding from where it's desperately needed to the already rich capital - medieval Britain has never known such political turbulence and wealth divide.

This won't do. You may currently be an ally but you're not in the inner circle - how long before you yourself are frozen out for the benefit of the chosen few? Those who have veiled themselves through bureaucracy, so no meaningful change can come through legal channels.

To challenge them would mean starting again, of course. Somewhere off the grid where you can escape regulations - when they cannot control you, perhaps then they will have to listen to you. If they still refuse? Well... you aren't above using force where it's morally called for - and you've always wondered how much greater this nation would be with you at the helm...

  • Explore Britain with a medieval touch - featuring 437 modern day British cities and towns in a medieval-inspired era, where will you choose to start your empire? Experience all of Britain's charm with a top-down, pixel art aesthetic!

  • Evolve your cities - manage your buildings, technologies, resources and population to evolve a hamlet into a bustling town and eventually into an era-defining metropolis!

  • Train your armies and conquer new territories - use your strategic guile to outwit your opponents and be on the right side of history! Can you plan ahead and make the right decisions to give your forces the best chance to succeed?

  • Form alliances and negotiate diplomacy - who will you choose as your allies, and whose time will come to an end at your hand? Will you keep your enemies close and lurk in the shadows, or fight your wars honourably in the open?

short_description: Evolve your hamlet into a mighty city, conquer territories with your armies and form alliances so that one day, you might have the power to Take London! Do it all safe in the knowledge that Taking London will never be pay-to-win - victory must always come through skill.
